6. We extend our gratitude to all Heirs who enjoyed the World Arena this season.

■ Pre-Ban The pre-ban rate here refers to the percentage of matches in which the Hero was pre-banned among all matches. For example, if a Hero's pre-ban rate is 50%, it means the Hero had been pre-banned for half of all the matches counted. ■ First Pick The term "First Pick" refers to the first Hero selected by the player assigned the First Pick role, with one Hero counted per match. For example, if a Hero has a 30% First Pick rate, it means that the First Pick player chose that Hero first in approximately 30% of all matches. The following data also shows the post-pick ban rate of the Heroes. ■ Pick The term "Pick" here refers to the Heroes selected by a player in a match, including their First Picks. If a certain Hero has a pick rate of 50%, it means the Hero has been drafted by either player in half of all matches.
